articles.title: OCC chief says Democrats applying sole political pressure in World Liberty charter choice
articles.snippet: The regulator rejected claims he's doing President Trump's bidding during a congressional hearing that also addressed the GENIUS Act stablecoin push.

articles.title: South Korea police probe Polymarket users over illegal gambling claims: Report
articles.snippet: South Korean police reportedly launched the country’s first illegal gambling probe into local Polymarket users amid election-betting scrutiny.

articles.title: Russia targets British 17-year-old for alleging digital assets were skirting sanctions
articles.snippet: Political activist Bill Browder, the teenager’s father, said his son was “the first high school student in the world to be sanctioned by an authoritarian regime” over a report on the ruble-pegged stablecoin A7A5.

articles.title: Republican Lawmaker Plans to Add Prediction Markets to Congressional Stock Ban Bill
articles.snippet: Rep. Bryan Steil said he'll add language to the House congressional stock ban bill to cover prediction markets like Polymarket and Kalshi.

articles.title: Crypto Billionaires Donate $9.4M to Farage’s Reform UK in Q1
articles.snippet: Tether investor Christopher Harborne and BitMEX co-founder Ben Delo’s outspent Britain's traditional political donors.
